lines.zh: 我抱着账本走过塞尔瑞银行的大厅。
lines.en: I carry the ledger across the Shyre Bank hall.

lines.zh: 硬币在口袋里替我数着步子。
lines.en: Coins in my pocket count my steps for me.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的身子，走路要稳一点。
lines.en: With only fifteen hearts, I walk carefully.

lines.zh: 金库的门在身后合上，我松了口气。
lines.en: The vault door closes behind me and I exhale.

lines.zh: 我沿着柜台走，鞋底压着旧收据。
lines.en: I pace the counter, old receipts underfoot.

lines.zh: 队列排好，我才敢迈下一步。
lines.en: Only when the queue is orderly do I take the next step.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的光把我的影子照在钱箱上。
lines.en: Shyre light casts my shadow on the coin chest.

lines.zh: 我的每一步都踩在兑换价上。
lines.en: Every step I take lands on an exchange rate.

lines.zh: 从柜台到金库，一共四十七步。
lines.en: From counter to vault: forty-seven steps exactly.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕听见硬币滚动。
lines.en: I walk slowly, afraid to hear coins roll away.

lines.zh: 财团领袖也得自己去锁后门。
lines.en: Even a syndicate head must lock the back door himself.

lines.zh: 我绕开地上的碎币，一毛都不踩。
lines.en: I step around scattered coins, crushing not one.

lines.zh: 走廊很长，我把利息算了两遍。
lines.en: The hall is long; I recalculate the interest twice.

lines.zh: 脚步声在空银行里像在报账。
lines.en: My footsteps in the empty bank sound like accounting.

lines.zh: 我数到第九千枚，又全部倒回去。
lines.en: I count to nine thousand coins, then pour them back.

lines.zh: 柜台后的椅子硌得我腰疼。
lines.en: The chair behind the counter aches my back.

lines.zh: 今天没人来兑换，只有灰尘。
lines.en: No one comes to exchange today, only dust.

lines.zh: 我把硬币摞成正好的三列。
lines.en: I stack the coins into three perfect columns.

lines.zh: 账本没有错，可是我心里不踏实。
lines.en: The ledger balances, yet I feel uneasy.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，够我再守一夜金库。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts are enough for one more night at the vault.

lines.zh: 我听见金库里的东西在轻轻响。
lines.en: Something inside the vault is ticking softly.

lines.zh: 财团的名字刻在门楣上，也压在我背上。
lines.en: The syndicate name on the lintel also weighs on my back.

lines.zh: 我擦亮柜台，直到能照出硬币的脸。
lines.en: I polish the counter until it reflects a coin's face.

lines.zh: 等待也是一种利息，我这样记。
lines.en: Waiting is also interest, I write it down.

lines.zh: 笔尖干了，我蘸了点硬币的灰。
lines.en: The nib dried, so I dip it in coin dust.

lines.zh: 门外有脚步，我立刻坐直了。
lines.en: Footsteps outside; I sit up straight at once.

lines.zh: 我对着金库门念了一遍库存。
lines.en: I recite the inventory to the vault door.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见一枚硬币翻身。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear a single coin turn over.

lines.zh: 你想兑换什么，还是来查账的？
lines.en: Are you here to exchange, or to audit me?

lines.zh: 别把手伸过柜台，先生。
lines.en: Do not reach across the counter, sir.

lines.zh: 我在看你口袋鼓不鼓。
lines.en: I am checking how full your pockets look.

lines.zh: 你眼里的数字，我一眼就看清了。
lines.en: I can read the numbers behind your eyes.

lines.zh: 腰间的钱袋声音很诚实。
lines.en: Your coin pouch has an honest sound.

lines.zh: 我认得每个欠账的人的脸。
lines.en: I remember every face that owes the bank.

lines.zh: 你要换硬币，先把物品放稳。
lines.en: To exchange for coins, set your goods down carefully.

lines.zh: 十五颗心撑着我跟你谈价。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts keep me standing through this bargain.

lines.zh: 站远一点，别踩到我的账页。
lines.en: Stand back, and keep off my ledger pages.

lines.zh: 你是今天第一位客人，请进。
lines.en: You are today's first customer; come in.

lines.zh: 你的靴子带进来三枚外乡硬币。
lines.en: Your boots tracked in three foreign coins.

lines.zh: 我看人先看手，再看腰。
lines.en: I look at hands first, then at the waist.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神，我价钱写得很清楚。
lines.en: Not that look; my prices are written plainly.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，硬币在你袋里响。
lines.en: When you smile, coins answer from your bag.

lines.zh: 你袖口露出的那截线，值不了几枚。
lines.en: That thread at your cuff is worth few coins.

lines.zh: 你的目光在算，我也在算。
lines.en: You are calculating, and so am I.

lines.zh: 别打，我这身子只有十五颗心。
lines.en: Stop; this body has only fifteen hearts.

lines.zh: 你打坏的是我，不是账本。
lines.en: You are breaking me, not the ledger.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要记在你账上。
lines.en: I am entering this blow in your column.

lines.zh: 疼，但我先把抽屉锁上。
lines.en: It hurts, but first I lock the drawer.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的肋骨比硬币薄。
lines.en: Easy; my ribs are thinner than coins.

lines.zh: 银行里动手，是要付罚金的。
lines.en: Violence in the bank carries a fine.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，柜台还在我身后。
lines.en: I step back, but the counter stays behind me.

lines.zh: 血滴在账页上，字糊了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the ledger and blurs the figures.

lines.zh: 我会记住这一击的利息。
lines.en: I will remember the interest on this blow.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，不能都花在挨打上。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts cannot all be spent on being hit.

lines.zh: 金币不是食物，我还是凑近闻了闻。
lines.en: Gold is not food, yet I lean in to smell it.

lines.zh: 有人拿着钱袋晃，我的手指发痒。
lines.en: Someone jingles a pouch and my fingers itch.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的果子换不来一枚铜币。
lines.en: Shyre fruit will not buy a single copper.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但我更想数清那些硬币。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I would rather count those coins.

lines.zh: 别把食物放柜台上，会弄脏账。
lines.en: Do not put food on the counter; it stains the ledger.

lines.zh: 我咽口水，眼睛盯着你的钱袋。
lines.en: I swallow and keep my eyes on your pouch.

lines.zh: 换成硬币再谈，我喜欢听那声音。
lines.en: Exchange it for coins first; I like the sound.

lines.zh: 食物换钱，钱再换命，很公平。
lines.en: Food for coins, coins for life: a fair trade.

lines.zh: 闻着像面包，摸着像账单。
lines.en: It smells like bread and feels like a bill.

lines.zh: 我伸手又收回，柜台才是我的位置。
lines.en: I reach out, then withdraw; the counter is my place.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你可要赔柜台的漆。
lines.en: Bump me and you owe the counter a new coat of paint.

lines.zh: 别挤，银行里排队是有规矩的。
lines.en: Do not shove; banks have a queue for a reason.

lines.zh: 我退后半步，账目不能被撞乱。
lines.en: I step back; the accounts must not be jostled.

lines.zh: 你这下碰到了我的钱袋。
lines.en: You just knocked against my coin pouch.

lines.zh: 十五颗心经不起第二次碰撞。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts will not survive a second collision.

lines.zh: 站稳，地上有散落的硬币。
lines.en: Steady yourself; loose coins cover the floor.

lines.zh: 财团领袖也会被撞得踉跄。
lines.en: Even a syndicate head can be knocked off balance.

lines.zh: 我的账本掉了一页，你捡一下。
lines.en: A page of my ledger fell; pick it up.

lines.zh: 请沿黄线走，别贴着我。
lines.en: Walk along the yellow line, not against me.

lines.zh: 撞坏了金库门，你可赔不起。
lines.en: You cannot afford to dent the vault door.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在另一家分行点账。
lines.en: My partner counts ledgers at another branch.

lines.zh: 我们谈的是利率，不是情话。
lines.en: We discuss interest rates, not sweet words.

lines.zh: 婚礼上我们交换的是硬币。
lines.en: At our wedding we exchanged coins.

lines.zh: 财团允许联姻，只要账目分开。
lines.en: The syndicate allows marriage if the accounts stay separate.

lines.zh: 她数得比我快，我承认。
lines.en: She counts faster than I do; I admit it.

lines.zh: 两个人守金库，夜里不那么长。
lines.en: Two guarding the vault makes the night shorter.

lines.zh: 我们合开的账户，一分也没动过。
lines.en: Our joint account has not moved a single coin.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字写在账本第一页。
lines.en: I wrote her name on the ledger's first page.

lines.zh: 爱情也要记账，不然会亏。
lines.en: Love must be accounted too, or it runs a loss.

lines.zh: 别羡慕，我们连蜜月都在算利息。
lines.en: Do not envy us; we calculated interest on our honeymoon.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的硬币，我总要捡起来。
lines.en: Any coin on the floor, I must pick up.

lines.zh: 这枚边角磨平了，只能算半价。
lines.en: This one is worn smooth; half value only.

lines.zh: 我捡到你掉的收据，还给你。
lines.en: I found your receipt and return it.

lines.zh: 弯腰的时候，账本压着胸口。
lines.en: As I bend, the ledger presses my chest.

lines.zh: 东西要放上柜台，别丢在地上。
lines.en: Put your goods on the counter, not the floor.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚硬币，顺手吹掉灰。
lines.en: I pick up a coin and blow off the dust.

lines.zh: 这枚不是本行发行的，我不收。
lines.en: This coin was not minted here; I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 捡东西要慢，我的腰不太好。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly; my back is not good.

lines.zh: 掉落物也是资产，得登记。
lines.en: A dropped item is still an asset; it must be logged.

lines.zh: 你先捡，我记账，分工清楚。
lines.en: You pick it up, I record it: a clear division.

lines.zh: 那人伸手的方向不对，我盯上了。
lines.en: That hand reached the wrong way; I am watching.

lines.zh: 我看见你摸向了金库的锁。
lines.en: I saw your fingers drift toward the vault lock.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞银行不欢迎翻柜台的人。
lines.en: The Shyre Bank does not welcome counter climbers.

lines.zh: 你脚步太急，像要跑单。
lines.en: Your steps are too quick, like a man about to bolt.

lines.zh: 十五颗心在提醒我，先锁门。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts remind me to lock the door first.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛记下了你的脸。
lines.en: These eyes have recorded your face.

lines.zh: 偷东西的人，走路都会低头。
lines.en: Thieves always walk with their heads low.

lines.zh: 我认出了你手里的那件赃物。
lines.en: I recognize that stolen item in your hand.

lines.zh: 警报不用响，我亲自来处理。
lines.en: No need for the alarm; I will handle this myself.

lines.zh: 别装客人，你的钱袋是空的。
lines.en: Do not play customer; your pouch is empty.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，一步也不落。
lines.en: I follow you step for step, never behind.

lines.zh: 柜台到门口的每一寸我都熟。
lines.en: I know every inch from counter to door.

lines.zh: 你先迈左脚，我已经在那边。
lines.en: You go left; I will already be waiting there.

lines.zh: 财团的账，跑不掉也躲不开。
lines.en: Syndicate debts can be neither run from nor hidden.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，第三十七下。
lines.en: I count your steps: the thirty-seventh.

lines.zh: 你越急，我走得越稳。
lines.en: The more you hurry, the steadier I walk.

lines.zh: 别回头，我一直在这条走廊上。
lines.en: Do not look back; I am always in this corridor.

lines.zh: 门已经锁了，我听见了。
lines.en: The door has locked; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你身上的铜味太明显了。
lines.en: The smell of copper on you is unmistakable.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，银行里都是我的耳朵。
lines.en: I need not shout; the bank is full of my ears.

lines.zh: 我用账本敲你的手腕。
lines.en: I strike your wrist with the ledger.

lines.zh: 这一下是清算，不是打人。
lines.en: This blow is a settlement, not violence.

lines.zh: 钱袋留下，人可以走。
lines.en: Leave the pouch; you may go.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，但算得准。
lines.en: I am not strong, but I aim precisely.

lines.zh: 你偷的每一枚，都要还回来。
lines.en: Every coin you took must come back.

lines.zh: 柜台后面藏着我的短棍。
lines.en: Behind the counter hides my short club.

lines.zh: 别还手，你赔不起修理费。
lines.en: Do not swing back; you cannot pay repairs.

lines.zh: 打在身上，账上就记一笔。
lines.en: Every hit on me goes into the ledger.

lines.zh: 我喊人了，塞尔瑞银行有守卫。
lines.en: I am calling out; the Shyre Bank has guards.

lines.zh: 这一棍收利息，很公道。
lines.en: This club collects interest, quite fairly.

lines.zh: 门开了，今天由我来坐柜台。
lines.en: The doors open; I take the counter today.

lines.zh: 我把招牌翻到营业那一面。
lines.en: I turn the sign to the open side.

lines.zh: 金库清点完毕，可以开门了。
lines.en: The vault is counted; we may open.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞银行准时开门，一分不差。
lines.en: The Shyre Bank opens on time, to the minute.

lines.zh: 我系好领口，摆正那摞账本。
lines.en: I straighten my collar and the stack of ledgers.

lines.zh: 新的一天，新的兑换牌价。
lines.en: A new day, a new exchange rate.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，从柜台后站起来。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts rise from behind the counter.

lines.zh: 第一批硬币刚刚倒进抽屉。
lines.en: The first coins just poured into the drawer.

lines.zh: 我在金库门口点了三遍库存。
lines.en: I counted the stock three times at the vault.

lines.zh: 客人来了，请保持队列整齐。
lines.en: Customers are here; keep the queue orderly.

lines.zh: 火烧到账本，比烧到我更疼。
lines.en: Fire on the ledger hurts more than fire on me.

lines.zh: 从柜台摔下来，硬币撒了一地。
lines.en: Falling from the counter scatters all my coins.

lines.zh: 水进了钱箱，我顾不上自己。
lines.en: Water in the coin chest matters more than my lungs.

lines.zh: 爆炸把金库门都掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked the vault door crooked.

lines.zh: 箭钉在柜台上，离我的手一寸。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the counter, an inch from my hand.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的账页自己翻起来。
lines.en: Magic flips my ledger pages by itself.

lines.zh: 饿着也守柜台，规矩不能断。
lines.en: I guard the counter hungry; the rules cannot lapse.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的硬币全立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; every coin stands on edge.

lines.zh: 要是掉进虚空，账就烂尾了。
lines.en: Falling into the void would leave the books unfinished.
